$comment: Region record (docs/DESIGN.md#regions-and-feeds). bbox: where this region's transit data applies, every system from Victoria to Port Hardy and Tofino to Gibsons, [west, south, east, north]. areas: where the site shows it, two rectangles round Metro Vancouver's bbox (south of 48.95° N, east to Victoria; north of it, east to Langdale). initialBounds: the first view of /transit when the URL has no map position (Victoria's routes, Langford to Swartz Bay and UVic).
name: Vancouver Island and Sunshine Coast
$timezoneChecks: Known facts about this region's time zone that the runtime's time zone data (tzdata, via ICU) must agree with; the server refuses to start otherwise (checkTimezoneData in packages/transit-core/src/time.ts). Times are still always computed from the runtime's data, never from these. BC moved to permanent UTC-7 in 2026 (tzdata 2026b, https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/NEWS); older data falls back to UTC-8 on 2026-11-01.

timezoneChecks.reason: British Columbia's permanent UTC-7 (tzdata 2026b or later)
